newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand and seller interest light to very light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lb few 68.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared with Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady in light test.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 109.50-110.00. Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00. Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1225 lb 110.00.
Wk to Date - 4,700 Week Ago - 11,600 Year Ago - 25,200
